_comment: Allowlist for fixture runs. Separate file, separate board identity.
The fixture mode used to run against config/sources-allowlist.json, which meant its
synthetic postings were written into the SAME source row as real collection from
greenhouse/vercel. Three invented jobs then sat in the catalog beside 50 real ones,
indistinguishable without reading the payload, and any count of that source was a
`fixture-demo` is not a Greenhouse board and never will be. Nothing is fetched from
it: in fixture mode the exporter's only transport is a loopback server replaying a
local file, so the board id is a label, not an address. It gets its own job_sources
row, so real and synthetic postings are separable by source_id alone.

evidence.why: Not a real board. Synthetic postings replayed from cmd/jdexport/testdata, used to exercise the pipeline end to end without touching a job site.
evidence.network: None. Fixture mode serves from a loopback httptest server and the rewriting getter refuses any URL that does not point at it.
